headlines.text: It was 2021 when MJF vs. Chris Jericho met in a Qualifying Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.58.
2023 brought us this moment: Hikaru Shida vs. Skye Blue vs. Ruby Soho vs. Toni Storm closed out Rampage, rated 6.75, part of the special Fight For the Fallen '23 - Night 2 card.

2021 brought us this moment: The Young Bucks vs. Jurassic Express put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a match that delivered. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2021, Sammy Guevara was back in action after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

Rewind to 2023, when the ROH World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as Aussie Open vs. Kassidy & Page went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.08. Kassidy & Page was challenging for gold for the very first time.
It was 2023 when Rey Fenix vs. Komander delivered a real highlight of the night on Rampage, rated 8.18, part of the special Fight For the Fallen '23 - Night 2 card.
